## Purpose

Discard a project's legacy ask/escalation cutover state and start fresh with only
open reviews that need a human decision. This is an explicit supervisor/operator
reset, never an automatic reconciliation step.

## Behavior and persistence

Preview is the default. It simulates a complete reset inside a rolled-back
transaction, returning counts, kept review IDs, mode/generation, evidence hash and
projected blockers. The total row bound defaults to 10000 and may be explicitly
raised to 100000; exceeding it refuses the entire operation.

Apply requires the same evidence hash in transferring or delivery-disabled mode.
Old asks are marked discarded, historical bindings retired, old delivery rows and
conflicts removed, inputs revoked and actions cancelled. Only live human reviews
become new ask IDs with fresh pending bindings. No transport is invoked and no
approval, gate resolution or decision replay occurs. One summary counts/hash
receipt and reset boundary survive restart. Accepted retries return that receipt.

## Diagnostics

`ask.reset_bound` requires a larger complete bound. `ask.stale_evidence` requires a
fresh preview. `ask.reset_unfenced` requires shadow migration for preview and a
fenced apply mode. `ask.reset_blocked` rolls back if any blocker would remain.
Only the operator or a live capability-granted global supervisor may call it.

## Usage

```text
aq ask legacy-reset --project-id agent-queue --max-rows 10000 --json
aq ask legacy-reset --project-id agent-queue --max-rows 10000 --apply --evidence-sha256 PREVIEW_HASH --json
```

Follow [the fresh-start rollout](../../guides/human-asks-rollout.md#explicit-fresh-start-2026-10-19-directive).
Deployment, live preview, apply and the separate channel switch belong to
supervisor-global. Source-test previews are not production acceptance.
